description: Defines the class TemplateRadioEnum, a PHP class extending TemplateEnum, for rendering and handling radio button enum fields in SuiteCRM. Includes methods for generating HTML, field definitions, search, and detail views.

classes.name: TemplateRadioEnum
classes.description: A PHP class for rendering radio button enum fields in SuiteCRM, extending TemplateEnum.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML snippet for editing the field.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including database type and separator.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares data for the edit template, including radio options.

methods.name: generateRadioButtons
methods.description: Generates HTML radio button options based on list strings.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Prepares data for search template with radio options.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns display value for detail view based on current bean.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns default database value, empty string.
